messages:
Kyle: Rolling rwd-v4-int8-lite into hosted perf tests now. Quick numbers: ~30% cost reduction, p95 latency +5ms. Saw a long-doc MRR delta about -1.9%. Proposing a micro-canary with slice-weighted gates and explicit slope-back.
Anya: Which slices are regressing and can you share the baseline numbers?
Kyle: Long-doc (>2500 tokens) MRR -1.9% vs rwd-v4-fp16 baseline; code-fence slice shows early-stop uptick +1.2%; kv-cache warmup hit-rate ~78% in sims.
Mohit: OK. Suggested canary plan: start_pct=0.5%, ramp_to=5%, ramp_hours=36, min_hours_at_step=6. Gates: weighted_mrr_delta_hold=1.0%, weighted_mrr_delta_rollback=2.0%, kv_hit_rate_rollback=0.75, entropy_zscore_hold=2.5. On hold do slope_back_steps [2,1] (%), on rollback revert to rwd-v4-fp16.
Anya: Add 100% shadow-compare for 24h and emit per-slice fidelity_slope (delta/sqrt(token_count)) so long docs don't dominate. Require cost win >=20% to auto-promote, otherwise manual approval.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by kyle 1733334444 start=2024-07-02T09:00Z canary_id=c-1733334444 target=/models/rwd-v4-int8-lite initial_pct=0.5
Kyle: I'll push the canary YAML and dashboard (longdoc MRR, per-slice z-scores, kv heatmap). Will log top-10 failing prompts on any hold/rollback and post here.
